title: Polynomial-Time Computability of the Trial Test
statement: The Boolean function that takes a bit string $z$, applies the total first and second projections of the pair encoding to obtain $Q$ and $R$, and returns the one-bit string containing the trial-test result on $(Q,R)$ is computable by a deterministic Turing machine in time bounded by a polynomial in the input length.
